card.name: Linking words in boxed warning risks
card.fires_on: Small linking words or punctuation (to, by, of, a comma, a slash) in warning text, just before a list of serious adverse effects. Often in all-caps boxed warnings or overdose sections.

modes.label: Links in all-caps warnings
modes.description: A linking word or comma in capitalized boxed-warning text, right before a named harm.
modes.example: AND ITS CONGENERS, SINCE THE CONCOMITANT ADMINISTRATION OF THESE TWO DRUGS CAN LEAD<< TO>> PHENYTOIN INTOXICATION

modes.label: Links in overdose lists
modes.description: A linking word or slash inside an overdose or toxicity description, before a symptom or sign.
modes.example: OVERDOSAGE Overdosage with colistimethate sodium can cause neuromuscular blockade characterized<< by>> paresthesia, lethargy

modes.label: Partway through warning headings
modes.description: The word of or the middle of a word in a warning headline.
modes.example: WARNING: RISK<< OF>> HEART FAILURE See full

card.plain: It fires on the small connecting words that come right before a list of serious harms in a warning.
